files.purpose_ownership: Survival ledger: what Phase 11 findings carried into desktop/, what died with JS, and the (unrun) npm check command.
Lockfile: @types/node 22.20.1, typescript 5.9.3 (devDependencies only), undici-types transitive. No runtime deps.
files.integration: retired, not built; not installed (npm install not run per audit rules)

files.purpose_ownership: Declares empty dependencies (deliberate supply-chain stance, per its own description field); typecheck+test scripts.
csvField (formula-injection guard), csvMoney (exact paise->decimal), csvSymbol+wouldBeRetyped (type-guessing guard). All three are correct in isolation.
files.integration: retired, not built. csvSymbol is never called from the real export path -- see C19-001.

files.purpose_ownership: exportRows generator (chunked CSV/TSV/JSONL), cellText, clipboardText. cellText calls csvField only, never csvSymbol -- see C19-001.
Extent (extensive/intensive/categorical), allowedAggregations, weightedMean, exact bigint Sum/Mean with roundRatio (half-away-from-zero). Verified correct against P11-05 acceptance tests.
Column pin/reorder/resize regions (pinnedLeft/scrolling/pinnedRight, mutually exclusive by construction) and resize clamping toward MIN_COLUMN_PX.

Derived-column expression parser: hand-rolled recursive-descent grammar (no eval/new Function), dimensional analysis (money/count exponent vectors), exact rational evaluation. Tokenizer rejects by character class, not blocklist -- reviewed for RCE (none found: no eval, no Function, no property access in grammar) and for recursion-depth DoS (bounded by MAX_EXPR_CHARS=512, so parens/unary-minus nesting <=~256-512 deep, well inside JS stack limits -- not exploitable).

Type-aware column filters: parseRupeesToPaise (string arithmetic, refuses sub-paisa precision), compareValues (bigint/number/string normalisation, refuses cross-type), IsAbsent/IsPresent. Ported near-verbatim into desktop/filter.hpp::parse_rupees_to_paise -- verified survival.
files.integration: retired, not built. Logic confirmed ported into live desktop/filter.hpp (see findings doc section 4).

files.purpose_ownership: formatSigned (explicit +/-, colour redundant with glyph), SignConvention (GreenUp/RedUp), heatScale (Linear/Percentile, built from filtered set not window), heatBucket (integer bigint arithmetic), FlashTracker (keys on value change not repaint).
files.integration: retired, not built. formatPaise/paise-in-int64 concept confirmed ported into desktop/format.hpp::format_paise.

files.purpose_ownership: groupBy (key function distinct from label function), pivot, checkAdditive (parts==whole reconciliation, extensive columns only). Verified pivot() applies the same agg/weight to group cells and the grand cell, so the reconciliation is well-founded.

Severity-tagged keymap; validateKeymap statically rejects bare/near-navigation/single-modifier destructive bindings; resolve()/confirm() two-step kill-switch (never a direct keydown->action path); editing-field guard.
files.integration: retired, not built. Two-step destructive confirmation concept present in live desktop/kill_switch.hpp (phrase-based rather than chord-based, different mechanism, same principle).

files.purpose_ownership: Selection keyed by RowId (never index); selectAll bounded to the view; retainVisible drops rows the filter no longer matches; statusBar routes through aggregate() so it inherits the extensive/intensive rule.

envelope() (min/max per pixel column, anti-aliasing summariser) vs decimate() (kept only to measure what sampling loses; never called from a render path). Half-open bucket boundaries verified correct.

RowStore: rows Map keyed by RowId, separate view array; patchCell/clearCell addressed only by id (no patchCellByIndex exists); Cell tagged union (present/absent, no numeric default); absent-last comparator.
files.integration: retired, not built. Row-identity-not-index principle confirmed carried into desktop/filter.hpp's token_at (proxy row -> source row -> token) mapping.

files.purpose_ownership: encodeFilters (schema~count~clauses, disclosure list for a copy-link control), decodeFilters (refuses whole on any malformed clause AND on a clause-count mismatch, which is what actually catches a semicolon-boundary truncation).
computeWindow: fractional (not multiplicative) scroll-to-content mapping above the 2^24 px spacer cap; scrollTopForRow inverse mapping; both proven pure/O(visible).

notes: All 25 assigned files (5,786 lines per the partition) were hashed before reading, read in full via the Read tool in chunks of <=300 lines with explicit re-reads at file tails to guarantee no line range was skipped, and re-hashed after. All sha256_before/after match sha256_inventory exactly -- no file changed during review. No npm/node/build command was run anywhere in this review (per hard rules); the README's '79/79' test claim was cross-checked structurally only, by grepping top-level `test(` declarations across all 14 client/tests/*.ts files (7 of which are in this group) -- the count is exactly 79, which is consistent with (but does not prove passage of) the README's claim. Three findings raised: C19-001 (csvSymbol anti-retyping guard never wired into the real export path), C19-002 and C19-003 (url.ts decodeFilters has no explicit upper bound on operand digit-string length or total clause count, unlike expr.ts's MAX_EXPR_CHARS). Five Phase-11-to-desktop survivals spot-checked by Grep/Read against desktop/filter.hpp, desktop/format.hpp and desktop/kill_switch.hpp: row-identity addressing, rupees-to-paise parsing (near-verbatim port), format_paise (near-verbatim port), blanks/absent handling, and the destructive-action two-step-confirmation principle (different mechanism: phrase confirmation vs chord validation, same principle) -- all confirmed present in desktop/, none found to carry a NEW defect not already in the retired client.
